newsitem.title: USA: Katz Digital names new president/COO.
newsitem.headline: Katz Digital names new president/COO.

text.p: Katz Digital Technologies Inc said Wednesday it has named Carl Grossman president and chief operating officer.
Most recently, Grossman was president and chief executive of Integrated Imaging Center.
Grossman succeeds as president Gary Katz, who remains chairman and chief executive of the company. The chief operating officer post is newly created, a spokesman said.
Katz Digital provides digital printing and pre-press services.
